iem.config.title: IEM Settings
iem.config.enabled.description: Spatializes positional effects with HRTF, including stereo sources. Turning this off restores the Minecraft directional audio setting.
iem.config.occlusion.description: Uses raycasts to smoothly attenuate volume and high frequencies through obstacles. Includes distance-dependent high-frequency attenuation. Does not double-filter processed SCAV voices.
iem.config.hrtf.description: Choose a detected HRTF dataset. Only the built-in profile is available unless additional datasets are installed.
iem.config.apply_note: Audio changes apply together when saved. Currently playing sounds will stop.
iem.config.gpu.description: Displays rendering timings for this session only.
iem.config.test.description: Saves changes, closes the screen, and plays sounds from the front, right, rear, left, above, and below. Keep your initial orientation in a quiet open area.
iem.config.diagnostics_note: Diagnostics are captured when this screen opens. Reopen it or use /iemaudio status to refresh.
